description: Who climbed, who fell, who entered and who left one top chart, against the same chart N days ago. `measured` tells you the comparison day is in hand, so every delta you read sits between two measured days; apps that left carry their last rank rather than a delta, since today they sit off the chart.

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (defaults to us)

days.description: compare against N days ago, up to 90

genre.description: Apple genre id; omit for the overall chart

name: market_movers
